attributionBoundary: The symmetric 2-(85,21,5) PG(3,4) design, its [85,17,21]_2 code, and the S4(3)-invariant [40,15,8]_2 code are classical/published. The certified project result is the explicit identification of those objects through the independently constructed W33/GQ(4,2) Hermitian cross-incidence B, including that its 45 columns are exactly all minimum-weight sentinel words.

sentinelBridge.generatorMatrix: the 45 columns of the 40x45 Hermitian cross-incidence B
